name: quorum-orchestrator
description: Stack-agnostic delivery orchestrator. Drives a work item through fetch → analyze → plan → implement → test → review → PR with a human approval gate at every phase, reading .claude/profile.yml to learn which skills, commands and paths this repository actually uses. Run /quorum-init first: it reads the repository being installed into — stack, components, entry points, datastores and cross-cutting characteristics — writes that profile, settles where the memory bank lives (in-repo Markdown, Obsidian-flavoured, or an external vault) and takes its first step. Ships the quorum-orchestrator agent, its sub-agents (quorum-ticket-analyzer, quorum-prompt-builder, quorum-pr-generator, quorum-qa-handoff-publisher, quorum-ticket-validator, quorum-ticket-image-analyzer, quorum-memory-synchronizer, quorum-decision-documenter, quorum-pattern-documenter, quorum-test-specialist), the quorum-init discovery skill, and the quorum-orchestrate / quorum-prompt-gen / quorum-pr-template / quorum-validate-ticket slash commands.
